Class InventoryManager

java.lang.Object
stockly.model.InventoryManager
public class InventoryManager extends Object
Central data-access object for the inventory.

This class owns the product list and is the single place where inventory rules live: validation, id generation, stock-status classification (via Product.getStockStatus()), CSV persistence and change notification.

The UI never manipulates the product list directly — it calls these methods and re-reads state through the getters, so every screen stays consistent after any change.

Author:
Tooba Akram & Abeeha Noor
